title: Naisumon
description:
For the homies by THE homie.

Modpack mainly for Cobblemon
body:
For the homies by THE homie. This pack is built around Cobblemon, with a focus on adding mods that expand and enhance the Cobblemon experience. Alongside those, it includes a handful of quality-of-life improvements to make the game feel smoother and more fun. I’ve also added a couple of personal utility mods—like auto-mining—so I can spend more time enjoying Cobblemon instead of grinding through vanilla Minecraft tasks. ## Credit to - **MissingMons [Cobblemon]** – by RedRibbonz, Alonzurro, IzetyXX **License:** Missingmon Asset Use License
